main_text.p: cum percepta. In Illa deniq; epilepsia,cuius causa est splen, dolor circa ipsius splenis sedem sentitur: interdum cū inflatione, saepius cum duritie, aut cum rugitu in finistro latere. Caeterae autem notae melancholicae iam commemoratae hoc epilepsiae genus consequuntur. Quae praeterea fit epilepsia à uenenata materia, causam obtinet, aut externa, quae à membrorum aliquo fursum ad cerebrū per neruos effertur. Cuius signa sunt manifestissima: ut scorpij punctura, aut uelpae in quopiam neruo facta: aut interna, quae uel est in pede, uel in manu, aut in dorso, aut in pectine, aut deniq; in aliquo uiscere. Est autem malignus uapor, quem percipit ęger furfum ad cerebrū ferri, quo primum obscuratur uisus, dein mox cadit ęger. Propterea cuiusdam pueri meminit Galenus, cui à crure ad femur, inde ad coxam, mox ad ceruicem, ad caput demum pertingere uidebatur uapor quidam, ex quo corripiebatur torpore, adeo ut non solum non sentiret, sed ne intelligere quidem ualeret. Alterum producit exemplum haud difsimile, cuiusdam qui frigidum uentum ad caput ascendere percipiebat. Nam ea materia in quibusdam neruosis

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "splen" and "scorpij" set as "splen" and "scorpij". The Greek-style accent-like mark over "ęger" is printed as a cedilla-e and kept. The word "furfum" is read with reasonable confidence; the first "ęger" and the second "ęger" are both read from the scan. Catchword "uosis" completes the word split at the line end "ner-". The underlined Q at the start of "Quae" is a print feature and is not transcribed.
